zh-CN.title: 是诸法空相
zh-CN.subtitle: 《心经》关于诸法与空相的段落
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这句经文把“空”放在诸法的描述中，适合用于展示概念、段落和版本三层之间的关系。
curatorialDescription: 本条不把“空”直接翻译成虚无；解释会随版本、注疏和研究传统展开。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充版本异文、注疏传统和英译措辞的比较。

en.title: These dharmas have the characteristic of emptiness
en.subtitle: A Heart Sutra passage on dharmas and emptiness
en.shortSummary: The line places emptiness within a description of dharmas and helps demonstrate the relation among concept, passage and version layers.
curatorialDescription: The record does not translate emptiness directly as nothingness; interpretation will be shown with editions, commentaries and scholarly traditions.
en.researchNote: Variant readings, commentary traditions and English wording still need comparison.
